To stay true to the tradition of releasing at least one new race map every year, I invested 2 weeks to build this map. This is technically quite demanding, because it requires good strafejumps on the one hand and good slide techniques on the other. I´m sure we will break the 19sec mark one day.

Forum: [https://www.quakeworld.nu/forum/topic/5058/ here]. Race 18 is designed for Quakeworld Race Mod only.
